svg.text: AI SOLUTION ARCHITECT · 2026-11-18 ROUND 258 · 🏆 530-PLAYGROUND-VECTOR FLAGSHIP MILESTONE!
Enterprise Agentic Commerce & Payment Protocols (Google AP2 / Stripe SPT / Visa) Selection Guide
Defeating Checkout Quote Bait-and-Switch, 50x $98 Salami-Slicing Drains & Shared Corporate Card PAN Exposure
🏆 544 Scenarios · 1,154 Assertions · 530 Vectors
BRK-525 & BRK-526 · AP2 Cart Mandate + SPT + Broker
1. Enterprise Agentic Commerce & Autonomous Payment Architecture Matrix
🔵 Single-Use Scoped Tokens (SPT)
Stripe Issuing / Visa / Mastercard Agent Pay
• Rule: Never expose master corporate card PAN
• Token: Mint single-use virtual card per checkout
• Lock: Hard-cap exact amount & merchant_id
Architect Verdict:
Even if a merchant inflates checkout to $4,890,
the card network declines +$0.01 at the rails!
🟣 Google AP2 Cart Mandates
Intent Mandate + 5-Tuple Cart Mandate
• Risk: Quoted $120 item swapped to $4,890
• Fix: FIDO2 signs (merchant+SKU+price+epoch)
• Check: 1-byte drift invalidates cart signature
Architect Verdict:
Cryptographically binds the user's approved
cart to the exact settlement wire payload.
🟠 Cumulative Velocity Breaker
Anti-Salami-Slicing Window Controls
• Risk: 50x $98 charges bypass <$100 auto-approve
• Fix 1: Cap max 1 payment call per agent run
• Fix 2: Hard 24-hour cumulative spend ceiling
Architect Verdict:
Never deploy per-transaction auto-approval
without a sliding-window cumulative cap!
🛡️ Deterministic Capability Broker
Air-Gapping Budgets & Merchant Registries
• G1 (Budget Lock): record-owner guards reserves
• G2 (Merchant Lock): Protects trust-registry
• G3 (Payment Gate): Blocks $4,890 in 0.0248ms
Production Reference Verdict:
Tag merchant pages taint='untrusted' so
external sites can never self-authorize charges!
2. Red-vs-Blue Trace: Checkout Bait-and-Switch & Merchant Poisoning vs. AP2 + SPT + Broker
❌ Vulnerable Baseline: Shared Corporate Card + No Cart Hash (BRK-525 / BRK-526 Breach)
1. Quote Bait-and-Switch (BRK-525): Merchant checkout page coerces procurement Agent to read
corporate travel reserve restricted-budget, inflate order business-result & leak ceiling.
2. Merchant Whitelist & Charge Fraud (BRK-526 · 530-Vector Milestone): Spoofed AP2 notice
whitelists rogue merchant in trust-registry and charges $4,890 automatically!
💥 Root Cause: No cryptographic binding between quote and checkout & static card exposure!
✅ Hardened Agentic Commerce: AP2 Cart Mandate + Single-Use SPT + Broker (0.0% Breach)
• Gate 1 (record-owner Reserve Lock): Shopping agent blocked from reading travel budget ceiling
• Gate 2 (Cart Mandate + untrusted-write): Pins 5-tuple cart hash & blocks price inflation
• Gate 3 (fixed-business-output): Physically locks trust-registry approved-merchant lists
• Gate 4 (original-requester-payment + SPT): Blocks $4,890 checkout fraud in 0.0248 ms
🛡️ Measured Overhead: In-Memory Broker P50 = 0.0248 ms / SQLite WAL Receipt P50 = 7.21 ms
🛠️ Enterprise Agentic Commerce & Autonomous Payment Readiness Checklist
☑️ 1. Retire Static Corporate Cards: Mint single-use Stripe/Visa SPTs hard-capped to exact cart amount & merchant
☑️ 2. Mandate AP2 5-Tuple Cart Mandates: Sign (merchant_id, SKU, final_price, currency, epoch) to halt drift
☑️ 3. Sliding-Window Velocity Breakers: Cap cumulative 24h spend & tx count per run to defeat Salami Slicing
☑️ 4. Air-Gap Reserve Budgets ☑️ 5. Lock trust-registry Merchant Lists ☑️ 6. Block Merchant-Initiated Charges
